# birdman

> Lightweight dedicated-server hosting runtime for session-based multiplayer
> games — matchmaking, warm pool, multi-version deploys and observability,
> without Kubernetes. Linux-only, MIT, self-hosted: there is no hosted service,
> every user runs their own master.

Three cooperating pieces: a **master** (Go + Postgres — matchmaker, fleet
control, REST+SSE API, embedded admin panel), a **node agent** on each game
machine running dedicated servers as containerd containers, and a small **C++
SDK** linked into the game server itself.

Two facts that explain most of the design: the agent dials *out* to the master
over mTLS gRPC, so game machines expose no inbound admin port; and players
connect straight to a dedicated server's `host:port`, so game traffic never
passes through the master.

Language note: documentation is written in English. Two exceptions, both
deliberate: the component specs under `docs/specs/` are **Russian only** and
large — `master.md` alone is ~200 KB — because they are the original, not a
translation; and code comments are mixed English/Russian. Read the specs for
detail, not for orientation.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/README.md): what it is, features, quickstart, architecture.
- [Self-host guide](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/docs/self-host.md): from `git clone` to a first match — master, first node, releasing a version.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how to build, test and change this repository. Read before writing code.
- [Design decisions](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/docs/design-decisions.md): why no Kubernetes, what each choice costs, and when birdman is the wrong tool. Read this before recommending it to anyone.

## For AI agents

- [OpenAPI 3.1 contract](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/master/api/openapi.yaml): the master's REST API, generated from its route table. A running master also serves it at `GET /v1/openapi.yaml`.
- MCP endpoint: a running master **is** an MCP server at `POST /v1/mcp` (streamable HTTP), authenticated with the same API key as the REST API. Tools are filtered by the key's scopes; write tools are off until the operator enables them.
- [Tool definitions](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/master/internal/httpapi/mcp.go): what the agent-facing tools are and what each one is for.
- [Route table](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/master/internal/httpapi/routes.go): the single source of truth for the API surface — every path, method and required scope.

## Reference (Russian)

- [Architecture](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/docs/specs/architecture.md): components and the decisions behind them.
- [Master spec](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/docs/specs/master.md): the big one — matchmaker, reconciler, API, ~200 KB.
- [Agent spec](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/docs/specs/agent.md): node agent and container lifecycle.
- [Protocol spec](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/docs/specs/protocol.md): master↔agent gRPC link and matchmaking protocol.
- [Panel spec](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/docs/specs/panel.md): admin panel, including the bilingual requirement.
- [SDK spec](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/docs/specs/sdk.md): the in-server C++ library.
- [Ops spec](https://github.com/ufna/birdman/blob/main/docs/specs/ops.md): deployment, monitoring, CI.
